title: ALERTS HAVE A STING
why: His order of 2026-10-14: the alert lane is one at a time, short, with its sting. Many alerts had no sound at all, so a siege, a clock warning or an event could come in silently. Each alert that takes the lane now plays a short sting of its rank, quiet and on the same sound bus as the medals: a low double pulse for a critical alert, two falling notes for a warning, two rising notes for an extraction or good news. An alert refreshed in place stings once.
now: Each alert that takes the lane now plays a short sting of its rank.
